info.name: Tasklume API
info.description: Tasklume backend test requests. Run Auth > Login first, then copy data.accessToken into the accessToken variable (Postman does this automatically via test scripts). Copy ids from responses into taskId / projectId / draftId / suggestionId as you go.

request.description: Returns 409 if the email already exists; just log in instead.

exec: const body = pm.response.json();
try { const val = body.data.id; if (val) pm.collectionVariables.set('userId', val); } catch (e) {}

request.description: Copy data.accessToken -> accessToken and data.refreshToken -> refreshToken.

exec: const body = pm.response.json();
try { const val = body.data.accessToken; if (val) pm.collectionVariables.set('accessToken', val); } catch (e) {}
try { const val = body.data.refreshToken; if (val) pm.collectionVariables.set('refreshToken', val); } catch (e) {}
try { const val = body.data.user.id; if (val) pm.collectionVariables.set('userId', val); } catch (e) {}

request.description: Rotates the refresh token: the old one stops working.

exec: const body = pm.response.json();
try { const val = body.data.accessToken; if (val) pm.collectionVariables.set('accessToken', val); } catch (e) {}
try { const val = body.data.refreshToken; if (val) pm.collectionVariables.set('refreshToken', val); } catch (e) {}
const body = pm.response.json();
try { const val = body.data.id; if (val) pm.collectionVariables.set('projectId', val); } catch (e) {}

request.description:
The signature is HMAC-SHA256 (hex) of the exact body bytes with WEBHOOK_SECRET. Compute it with:

printf '%s' '{"id":"evt_test_001","type":"test.event","data":{"hello":"world"}}' | openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac "$WEBHOOK_SECRET" | awk '{print $2}'

Send twice to see the duplicate response. Change the id for a new event; recompute the signature after any body change.
